title: TrainingPeaks TSS Weekly Trend
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(tss) as total_value avg(tss) as avg_value count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends training stress score week by week so you can see whether trainingpeaks tss is building, fading, or plateauing.
value: A weekly view turns isolated workouts or events into a training signal, making it easier to spot whether trainingpeaks tss is moving in the right direction.
implementation: Forward trainingpeaks tss into `index=personal`, keep `tss` populated, and review the weekly trend before planning the next block.
visualization: Line chart of weekly total and average training stress score.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how trainingpeaks tss changes from week to week so you can tell whether training or racing is moving the right way.
